references.observed: IBM Plex Serif 700 hero; IBM Plex Sans 400 body; IBM Plex Mono 500 navigation and controls
Editorial serif hierarchy, generous leading, restrained utility typography; current site uses Lora, Inter and IBM Plex Mono

decision: Use the exact Raven Plex families already bundled locally under the existing OFL license. Keep one consistent product hierarchy rather than adding a second serif family.

roles.section_heading: IBM Plex Serif 600, existing section sizes, line-height 1.25
roles.body_and_descriptive_subtitle: IBM Plex Sans 400, sentence case, comfortable leading
roles.navigation_tabs_buttons: IBM Plex Mono 500; existing responsive sizes and touch targets

include: Button and button-style link labels, disclosure actions and accessible action labels
exclude: Input values, code, addresses and SVG chart labels
Descriptive paragraphs, small copy and explicit data-action-description content inside rich buttons
capitalization.behavior: Capitalize the first letter of each word, including hyphenated words. Preserve financial acronyms, mixed-case asset names and numeric tokens. Uppercase source headings become Title Case.

example.heading: Borrow On Your Terms.
example.subtitle: Set the collateral, debt and constraints. Compare the same intent across integrated venues.

implementation: Shared stylesheet and heading normalizer cover app, asynchronously rendered views, dialogs, design review and specification pages. Native text nodes are updated without replacing elements or action bindings.
